_commenton_controls: control_genes is negative controls to normalize to. poscon_genes is positive controls to check for expected phenotypes.
_commenton_controls2: control_genes is required. poscon_genes is optional.
_commenton_compartments: List compartments in experiment. First in list should be experimental unit and Parent object for Foci e.g. Cells
_commenton_compartments2: All compartments must have a Parent or Child relationship to the experimental unit so that cell_id_cols (default ImageNumber and ObjectNumber) can be used to merge them.
_commenton_library: match_to_library:true if barcode calls need to happen in recipe. match_to_library:false if matching happened during image analyis.
_commenton_library2: library_structure is dictionary where keys are columns to match, in order. Values are {n: length to match, namecol: column with names to match}.
